Idol Store is a personal app catalog that lists curated apps directly from public GitHub release pages and lets you search, browse by category, and download and install the latest stable version of each app with one tap. The app has no intermediate server: all catalog data is read from a public GitHub repository and APK files are downloaded straight from GitHub servers. Our goal is fast, transparent, no-middleman access to trusted apps. The app is free — if you find an app useful, consider starring its repository on GitHub to support the developer.

string-array.name: privacy_items
string-array.item: 1. What we collect

Idol Store has no central server and stores none of your data on our side. The only data processed is: public GitHub repository and release information (name, description, icon and APK file), app install status kept only on this device, and — for admin sign-in — the GitHub token, which is stored exclusively in encrypted storage on the device itself.
2. Account and email

For registration, your email is never stored in plain text; only a salted hash (SHA-256) of it is written to the public users.json file on GitHub. Your device token is also hashed and derived from this device fingerprint, so the stored data cannot be reversed into your real email or token.
3. Network connections

The app connects only to official GitHub services (api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com) and downloads APK files directly from GitHub servers. No data is sent to any other server or service, and your data is never used for advertising or sold.
4. Notifications
Update notifications are enabled only for apps you explicitly opt in to from that app page. Notification content is built solely from public GitHub release information.
5. Data deletion
Signing out wipes local tokens from device storage. To fully delete your registration record, contact the developer via email or Telegram and your hashed record will be removed from users.json.

string-array.name: terms_items
string-array.item: 1. Nature of the service

Idol Store is a personal app catalog that displays apps, versions and installable files from public GitHub release pages and enables direct download and installation. The app is free of charge and reselling it is not permitted.
2. Content responsibility

The publisher of each app is solely responsible for its licensing, correctness and security. Idol Store is only a display and download interface and does not produce or officially security-review the listed apps. Check app permissions before installing it.
3. Permitted use

Use of this app must comply with applicable law, GitHub terms of service and the intellectual-property rights of developers. Illegal use, attempts to bypass the registration system, or redistributing downloaded files as your own product is prohibited.
4. Accounts
Each device may be registered with exactly one email and each email with exactly one device. Attempting duplicate registrations, sharing tokens, or abusing admin access results in access revocation.
5. No warranty

The service is provided “as-is” with no warranty of fitness, availability or error-free operation. Downloading, installing and using any app is at your own risk. These terms may be updated with app releases; the valid version is the one shown on this page.
